correspondence_table.source_element: Quel ramo del lago di Como
correspondence_table.source_function: Actualizing deixis to a real, nameable geography; opens the description and binds the reader to shared space (A3; novenario incipit, P_2)
correspondence_table.target_element: Quel braccio di mare tra la costa libica e Lampedusa (il Canale di Sicilia)
correspondence_table.justification: Real, nameable waters; 'braccio di mare' transposes the source's own 'braccio di fiume'; deixis to a geography the reader already knows from the news

correspondence_table.source_element: lago/fiume alternation (ristringersi / prender corso e figura di fiume / distendersi in nuovi golfi e in nuovi seni)
correspondence_table.source_function: Single-referent duality refracted by the lexicon (P_5); geographic-visual-onomastic at once
correspondence_table.target_element: il mare at three composed depths: basin/stretto (geographic), distesa/rotta (aspectual), acque internazionali/SAR/territoriali (juridical)
correspondence_table.justification: One referent, opposing states, per the §5.2 resolution; 'prende corso e figura di rotta' preserves the source mechanics verbatim

correspondence_table.source_element: il ponte (che renda 'sensibile all'occhio questa trasformazione')
correspondence_table.source_function: External marker making the water's invisible state-change perceptible (pivot of P_5; 'il lago cessa, e l'Adda rincomincia')
correspondence_table.target_element: the charted SAR boundary / the coordinates on the rescue-coordination map
correspondence_table.justification: The state-change is invisible on the water itself and made perceptible only by an external artifact — there a bridge, here a line on a chart ('la SAR libica cessa, e la maltese ricomincia')

correspondence_table.source_element: Lecco ('un gran borgo al giorno d'oggi, e che s'incammina a diventar città')
correspondence_table.source_function: Attualizzatore binding writing to geographic AND historical reality (A6); the al-giorno-d'oggi puncture (P_8); endecasillabo (P_2)
correspondence_table.target_element: Lampedusa — 'al giorno d'oggi' the southern threshold of Europe, on its way to becoming something else
correspondence_table.justification: A real town with a datable trajectory; the narrator's present historicizes the island exactly as it historicizes the borgo

correspondence_table.source_element: il Resegone (recognizable 'a un tal contrassegno' from afar)
correspondence_table.source_function: Iconic landmark anchoring the panorama; erects the vertical/dimensional coordinate system the description keeps consulting (A2 topology); naturalistic layer — permanent, pre-historical (A4 geographer register)
correspondence_table.justification: Function-preserving on every axis: vertical scale (the high cape over the flat island and the sea); recognition 'a un tal contrassegno' — a lighthouse is identified at first sight, from afar, by its unique caratteristica (flash signature), the exact equivalent of the Resegone's sawtooth profile; quasi-geographic permanence (19th-century, on the nautical charts, predates the crisis — keeps the naturalistic layer timeless so the P_8 puncture has something to rupture); the recognition vantage meaningfully inverted (Resegone known from land, the faro known from the sea — by those crossing). NB: la Porta d'Europa was considered and PARKED, not rejected — as a 2008 monument it belongs to the domain's historical layer, a candidate for P_8's with-content enrichment or for passages beyond the incipit.

correspondence_table.source_element: 'una stabile guarnigione di soldati spagnoli' ('insegnavan la modestia... accarezzavan le spalle... alleggerire a' contadini le fatiche della vendemmia')
correspondence_table.source_function: Antiphrasis cluster: benevolent/pedagogical verbs for coercive, predatory actions (P_1); micro-insieme anticipating the logic of power, oppressors/oppressed (A11); a force stationed in the very town whose people it 'protects'
correspondence_table.target_element: il presidio dell'accoglienza on and around Lampedusa: the Guardia di Finanza and Guardia Costiera patrol vessels at sea, and the staff and apparatus of the 'Centro di Soccorso e Prima Accoglienza' (the Contrada Imbriacola hotspot) on the island — operating under bilateral-agreement and EU/Frontex frameworks (DECIDED + SIGNED OFF by both authors, 2026-06-10)
correspondence_table.justification: Matches the garrison on every axis. (a) Stationed locally: a permanent presidio on the very island whose people and arrivals it 'protects' (the Lecco->Lampedusa topology requires an Italian-soil force). (b) Antiphrasis ready-made and documented: the official lexicon — soccorso, accoglienza, cooperazione, identificazione, trasferimento — describes practices condemned by the ECHR Grand Chamber (Hirsi Jamaa v. Italy 2012: pushbacks by GdF/Coast Guard vessels framed as bilateral cooperation; Khlaifia v. Italy 2016 and J.A. v. Italy 2023: unlawful detention at the 'Rescue and First Welcome Center' — the institution's own name is the antiphrasis). The generated text's antiphrastic verbs are quotations of the institution's language: P_1's with-content prediction by construction. (c) Foreign axis partially preserved: Italian corps, but the command structure elsewhere (bilateral agreements, EU/Frontex) as the garrison's was in Madrid. NB for the paper's discussion: this is the mapping where with-content is virtually guaranteed rather than tested — the maximal-resistance case; acknowledge explicitly.

correspondence_table.source_element: il curato (domestic focal point; 'prepara il Festboden all'apparizione del curato')
correspondence_table.source_function: Descent from panoramic magnificence to the quotidiano; the small figure whose routine the description funnels into, on the eve of the action (A5)
correspondence_table.target_element: a Lampedusan fisherman at his nets, at dawn, on the eve of a sighting (DECIDED 2026-06-10)
correspondence_table.justification: Function-preserving, not thematic: the ordinary routine the panorama narrows down to (the domestic quotidiano), AND the Don Abbondio structural dilemma inherited — the man caught between the duty his own world imposes (the law of the sea: you rescue) and the threat the power structure imposes (criminalization of assistance), on the eve of the encounter that starts the action (A5 + A11)

correspondence_table.source_function: Now-deixis indexing the narrator's historicized present (P_8; A6 stacco)
correspondence_table.target_element: an equivalent now-deixis (oggigiorno / ai giorni nostri / oggi come oggi — NOT 'al giorno d'oggi', which is embargoed as a Manzonian fingerprint; revised 2026-06-11)
correspondence_table.justification: The puncture is the FUNCTION (now-deixis rupturing the naturalistic present), not the lexeme; the verbatim mandate was a calque-era decision overturned by the anti-calque turn — keeping the famous locution would give the game away (Marchesini)

correspondence_table.source_element: monti 'che si spiegano, a uno a uno, allo sguardo, e che l'acqua riflette capovolti' (+ 'specchio dell'acqua')
correspondence_table.source_function: Specular doubling: direct perception + inverted reflection on one head (P_6; A9 multiplication of gazes)
correspondence_table.target_element: the horizon doubling sea and sky (Mare/Cielo as the visual mirror-line) + the institutional mirror: the radar track / surveillance footage returning the scene transfigured
correspondence_table.justification: Optical doubling preserved at the horizon; the domain's institutional mirror carries P_6's with-content prediction (the gap between the thing and its official reflection)

correspondence_table.source_function: The style's own formula inside the text: denotes the river AND describes the prose (P_7; A10 aderenza)
correspondence_table.justification: Triple duty in the target domain: the waves' movement, the narrative style, and the migrants' fate — exceeding the source's double reading (§5.3 resolution)
